During a '''battle''' in the [[Mon Gazza system/Legends|Mon Gazza system]], the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] defeated the forces of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Par Lankin]]. The battle was part of the larger [[Nagai–Tof War]].<ref name="TEA" />
